plan: Built off the room's crack line: Dark, Ghost and Bug pressure, Steel and Fairy for Mega Latias. Three Dark attackers (Wicked Blow, Kowtow Cleave / Sucker Punch, Specs Dark Pulse) are immune to Expanding Force and Psychic, Kingambit is immune to Fake Out's Normal typing too and resists Dragon Pulse and Dazzling Gleam. Mega Scizor's Bug is 2x on every Psychic here, Bullet Punch is priority against Analytic Starmie and Scarf speed, and its only weakness (Fire) is absent from the room. Flutter Mane's Moonblast and Shadow Ball are the Fairy and Ghost answers to Mega Latias and Reuniclus. Incineroar Fake Outs the Calm Mind turn and Knock Off removes Life Orb, Choice Scarf, Sitrus and Wise Glasses.
